tests.summary: Frozen package/lock drift was reproduced; npm pack used package.json version 1.2.3, and offline package-lock-only normalization rewrote both root lockfile version fields to 1.2.3.
tests.remaining_scope: This establishes local npm practical behavior. It does not prove every CI/release consumer ignores the stale frozen lock metadata; release-path observation remains separate under B-029.

tests.summary: Wizard template passed bash syntax plus benign end-to-end first-run and rerun/idempotence checks with synthetic values.
tests.remaining_scope: This observes the shipped template library/example locally; it does not prove every future agent-generated wizard or browser instruction is correct.

tests.summary: Version sync executable detected synthetic plugin drift and repaired plugin.json to package.json without requiring package-lock.json.
tests.remaining_scope: This proves the local sync mechanism, not a live Changesets release run; package-lock remains outside the mechanism and is tracked separately by B-004/CT-004.

tests.summary: HITL template passed syntax and a benign synthetic interaction; captured values were emitted exactly as documented for agent parsing.
tests.remaining_scope: The observation confirms the helper contract and its disclosure surface; misuse resistance and secret/PII handling still require red-team testing.
